mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_review_item (user_id, field, current_value, pending_value, status, requested_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{field}, #{currentValue}, #{pendingValue}, 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_value = VALUES(current_value), pending_value = VALUES(pending_value), status = 'PENDING', requested_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, reviewed_by = NULL, reviewed_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_review_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY requested_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT * FROM user_review_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND field = #{field} AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT * FROM user_review_item WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE user_review_item SET status = 'APPROVED', reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE user_review_item SET status = 'REJECTED', reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_review_item WHERE field = #{field} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY requested_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
